MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 24

2. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 8
   C. 24.5
   D. 7

3. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 3
   C. 15
   D. 21

5. Solve for x: x + 8 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 16
   D. 8

6. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.25

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 36
   C. 22
   D. 18

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

9. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 10

10. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

13. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 0
   D. 17

14. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

16. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 11
   C. 24
   D. 25

17. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

18. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

19. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 105
   C. 30
   D. 44

20. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

21. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

22. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

23. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

24. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
